exposure: Type of caesarean section (planned or unplanned)
Transfer of newborn to intensive care or neonatology unit
outcome: Partner experience/satisfaction (evaluated by First-Time Father Questionnaire - FTFQ)
cohort: The study included 100 partners of women who underwent a planned or unplanned caesarean section in a single maternity hospital.
finding: Partners were generally satisfied with their attendance at the caesarean section, but satisfaction was significantly decreased if the newborn was transferred to the intensive care or neonatology unit.
mod_finding: Partner satisfaction with attending a caesarean section was high and did not differ based on whether the caesarean was planned or unplanned.
cross-section timing: Data was collected during a two-month period (1st November 2020 - 1st January 2021) focusing on experiences during and immediately after the caesarean section.
